title: 2018 ESC/ESH Guidelines for the Management of Arterial Hypertension

definitions.Resistant Hypertension: BP ≥140/90 mmHg on ≥3 antihypertensive drugs including a diuretic
definitions.Hypertensive Emergency: Acute BP elevation with end-organ damage

recommendations.text: Drug treatment should be initiated alongside lifestyle measures in all patients with Grade 2 or 3 hypertension.
The recommended BP target in treated hypertensive patients <65 years is SBP 120–129 mmHg; in patients ≥65 years: 130–139 mmHg.
A single-pill combination of two drugs is recommended as initial therapy for most patients to improve adherence.
The preferred two-drug combination is a RAS blocker (ACEi or ARB) with CCB or thiazide/thiazide-like diuretic.
If BP not controlled on dual therapy, a three-drug single-pill combination of ACEi/ARB + CCB + thiazide is recommended.
For resistant hypertension, addition of low-dose spironolactone (25–50 mg) is recommended as fourth agent.
Combination of ACEi with ARB is not recommended in hypertension.
ABPM and HBPM are recommended for confirmation and phenotyping of hypertension (white coat, masked).
Lifestyle measures (salt restriction to <5g/day, weight loss, regular aerobic exercise, moderate alcohol, Mediterranean diet) are recommended for all hypertensive patients.
In hypertensive patients with CKD (eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73m²), ACEi/ARB is recommended; monitor eGFR and potassium.
Beta-blockers can be used at any step when there is a specific indication (HF, post-MI, angina, AF).

pharmacotherapy.examples: ramipril 2.5–10 mg, perindopril 4–8 mg, enalapril 5–40 mg
pharmacotherapy.indication: First-line or component of SPC; preferred in DM, proteinuria, post-MI

indapamide 1.5 mg SR, chlorthalidone 12.5–25 mg, HCTZ 12.5–25 mg

key_trials.name: SPRINT
key_trials.finding: Intensive SBP <120 vs <140 reduced CV events 25% and mortality 27%

key_trials.name: HOPE-3
key_trials.finding: Candesartan+HCTZ reduced stroke; combined CV benefit in intermediate-risk

key_trials.name: ASCOT-BPLA
key_trials.finding: Amlodipine ± perindopril superior to atenolol ± HCTZ for CV events

key_trials.name: ACCOMPLISH
key_trials.finding: Amlodipine+benazepril superior to HCTZ+benazepril for CV events

key_trials.finding: Spironolactone most effective 4th-agent in resistant hypertension
